# @cosmjs/socket Agent Guide

> **Package**: `@cosmjs/socket` v0.38.0 **Purpose**: WebSocket client utilities
> **Layer**: Transport Layer

## Package Overview

Low-level WebSocket client for browser and Node.js environments. Used by
`@cosmjs/tendermint-rpc` for WebSocket connections.

### Key Features

- **Cross-platform**: Works in browsers and Node.js
- **Stream-based**: Returns xstream observables
- **Auto-reconnect**: Optional reconnection logic
- **Type-safe**: Full TypeScript support

## Common Usage

```typescript
import { StreamingSocket } from "@cosmjs/socket";

const socket = new StreamingSocket("wss://rpc.cosmos.network/websocket");

// Send message
socket.send(JSON.stringify({ method: "subscribe", params: {} }));

// Receive messages
socket.events.addListener({
  next: (message) => console.log("Received:", message),
  error: (err) => console.error(err),
  complete: () => console.log("Connection closed"),
});

// Cleanup
socket.disconnect();
```
